company.name: Codag
company.shortDescription: Codag provides tools that compress infrastructure logs into compact, cited text for debugging with AI agents.
company.description: Codag provides developer tools that compress infrastructure log data into compact, structured text that AI agents can process. The platform groups similar log lines into templates, ranks patterns, and preserves surrounding context with references to real line numbers. Codag offers a hosted service, CLI, SDKs, and MCP integrations that sit in front of large language model agents. Developers can wrap existing log commands so that agents receive compact text instead of raw log streams. The system supports line-oriented formats such as JSON logs, syslog, Kubernetes logs, and other application logs with preprocessing and redaction. Codag is used to help agents debug distributed systems by turning high-volume logs into cited evidence within token limits.
